question_text:
Electronic voting machines were used in general elections of state legislative assemblies
for the first time in 1998 in the following states:
a)
Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh
b)
Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar
c)
Madhya Pradesh and Kerala
d)
Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan and Delhi
1998 

a)


c)

d)

